assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.emptyState: Ask about stock levels, low-stock items, pending recommendations, or recent movements.
assistant.neverGuessesTitle: Answers come only from your stock data
assistant.neverGuessesBody: Mizan looks up the real figures first, then puts them into words. Every answer lists the records it used.
assistant.suggestLow: Which products are low on stock?
assistant.suggestCoffee: How much coffee do we have?

dashboard.glance: Here's your inventory at a glance.
dashboard.needReorderBody: The AI Store Manager flagged items running low. Review and approve what to order.
dashboard.movementTrendSub: Goods in vs. goods out, last 14 days

products.title: Products
products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or barcode
products.name: Product
products.noPositions: No stock recorded for this product yet.
products.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}}? This works only if it has no stock or movement history — otherwise deactivate it instead.

form.requiredMissing: Please fill in SKU, both names, and the unit.
form.unitEditNote: Existing stock is unaffected by edits.

import.title: Import products from Excel
import.hint: Download the template, fill it in, then upload. Rows are validated first — nothing is imported unless every row is valid.

barcode.scanReadyBody: Point the scanner at a barcode. You don't need to tap anything first.
barcode.scanTakeOverBody: Another field is listening for the scanner. Tap here to switch it to this one.

movements.title: Record Stock Movement
movements.noActivity: No movements yet. Set the location, then scan products against it.
movements.setLocationsFirst: Set the location(s) above to begin scanning products.
movements.noChange: The counted quantity matches the record — nothing to adjust.

replenishment.posCreated: Created {{count}} purchase order(s); {{skipped}} item(s) skipped (no supplier).
replenishment.empty: No recommendations yet. Run the review to check what needs reordering.

purchaseOrders.intro: Orders are grouped by supplier, one per supplier per approval run. They are emailed as PDF when generated from Replenishment.
purchaseOrders.generateHint: Approve recommendations in Replenishment, then generate orders there.

suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}}? This works only if no product or purchase order uses this supplier — otherwise deactivate it instead.

users.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}}? This works only if they have no recorded activity — otherwise deactivate them instead.
users.endSessionsHint: Sign this person out of every device now
users.endSessionsConfirm_one: {{name}} is signed in on 1 device. They will be signed out there at once and must sign in again.
users.endSessionsConfirm_other: {{name}} is signed in on {{count}} devices. They will be signed out on all of them at once and must sign in again.
users.resetMfaConfirm: Use this when {{name}} has lost or replaced their phone. Their two-step sign-in is cleared and they are signed out everywhere. They will set it up again at their next sign-in.

reports.stockOnHandDesc: Current quantity and status for every product.
reports.stockMovementsDesc: The recent movement ledger — in, out, transfer, adjustment.

cycleCount.noCounts: Scan a location, then products, to record counts.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.intro: Set how this deployment is branded — the name shown across the app, and its defaults. Changes apply immediately.
settings.codeHint: Fixed identifier for this deployment. It never changes.
settings.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings.

auth.accountLocked: This account is locked. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

locations.title: Storage Locations
locations.previewBeforeCommit: Review the {{count}} locations below before creating them.
locations.selectHint: Select a shelf to see the stock stored there.
locations.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{designator}} and everything under it (racks, levels)? This works only when it holds no stock at all — if any shelf still has items, transfer them to another location first.

stock.adjustmentReasonRequired: Give a reason for this adjustment (at least 10 characters).

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Your work is saved and will sync when you are back online.

insights.title: Predictive Analytics
insights.subtitle: Data-driven forecasts of stockouts, usage trends and reorder spend — every figure traces back to real stock and movement records.
insights.kpiSpendSub: Recommended quantities x unit cost, for products needing reorder now
insights.stockoutPanelSub: Most at-risk products, ranked by days of cover left (30-day average usage)
insights.stockoutEmpty: No products have enough recent usage to estimate days until stockout.
insights.forecastPanelSub: Historical daily usage against the demand forecast for the selected product
insights.forecastBuilding: Building forecast — {{days}} of {{min}} days of history needed
insights.forecastEmpty: No usage history recorded yet for this product.
insights.forecastUnavailable: The forecasting service is temporarily unavailable.
insights.spendPanelSub: Recommended order quantity x unit cost, for every product currently at or below its reorder point
insights.spendEmpty: Nothing needs reordering right now — no projected spend.

briefing.allClearBody: Stock is healthy, nothing is waiting for approval and every scan has synced. The next review runs tomorrow at 07:00.
briefing.humanDecides: Mizan recommends, you decide. Nothing is ordered until an administrator approves it.
briefing.approveHint: Each recommendation shows the numbers behind it. Change the quantity before approving if you need to.
briefing.qtyInvalid: Enter a whole number above zero.
briefing.runningOutHint: Products that will run out within 7 days and are not yet waiting for approval.
briefing.runningOutReason: {{stock}} left, using about {{usage}} a day, so it lasts about {{days}} days.

scanSignal.duplicateDetail: The same label was scanned twice. The second scan was ignored.

compliance.badgeTitle: All data and the AI stay on this organisation's own server. Nothing goes to the cloud.
compliance.headline: Your data never leaves this building
compliance.promiseDataBody: Stock, users, orders and the audit trail are kept in a database on this organisation's own server.
compliance.promiseAiBody: The AI Store Manager and the assistant run on the same server. No question or figure is sent to an outside AI service.
compliance.promiseEmailBody: The only outbound connection is email, used to send approved purchase orders to suppliers.
compliance.controlsIntro: Every control required by the Dubai Electronic Security Center, with its current status taken directly from the compliance evidence file. Open a row to see where it is implemented.

control.14: Secrets kept out of the code

idleTimeout.title: Still there?
idleTimeout.body: For security you'll be signed out in {{seconds}} seconds because nothing has happened for a while.
idleTimeout.signedOut: You were signed out after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.

mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown for Mizan.
mfa.enrollBody: Your organisation requires a second step at sign-in. Scan this code with an authenticator app (such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manualKeyLabel: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
mfa.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app.
